---
title: "Tutorials"
---

Hands-on materials for the summer school. Each tutorial lives in its own folder
in the
[repository](https://github.com/stefanradev93/sbi4cogsci/tree/main/tutorials)
and states its **own** requirements and how to run it. There is no repo-wide
required toolchain: some tutorials run entirely in Google Colab, some are
self-contained, and the BayesFlow/HSSM notebooks share a `uv` environment at
the `tutorials/` root (see
[`tutorials/README.md`](https://github.com/stefanradev93/sbi4cogsci/blob/main/tutorials/README.md)).

     Tutorial  = link to the rendered site page if one exists, plain text otherwise.
     Stack     = free text (e.g. "Python · marimo + uv", "MATLAB R2024b", "Colab", "none — slides").
     Run       = ONE inline-code command, a link for Colab-hosted tutorials, or "materials only".
     Materials = always the GitHub folder link.
     One row per rendered page (a day folder holding several sessions gets several rows). -->
